subject: Initial legal entity & invoicing onboarding for Stratus Supply

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial legal entity & invoicing onboarding for Stratus Supply

Hi Jordan / Stratus accounts team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get Stratus set up as a Redwood vendor. To get the vendor master created and enable PO issuance and ACH payments we need the following items from you: 

- Legal entity name exactly as it appears on tax filings
- W-9 (or W-8 if non-US)
- Remittance address for invoices
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing, account type)
- Primary AP contact name, phone, and email

I've attached our vendor onboarding form to speed things up. If you prefer, we can kick off the DocuSign packet linked below and have the AP contact return the signed forms. Once we receive the above we will open a vendor record and issue a PO for the initial purchase.

Next steps
- Jordan: confirm whether you will send the completed forms and bank details or if we should route the DocuSign packet to someone in AP.
- Dev / Marissa: I will hand off intake to finance once we have the completed docs.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_evelyn_20280509.pdf (vendor intake form)
DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/STRATUS-2028-05

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0126
From: Jordan Blake <j.blake@stratus-supply.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@stratus-supply.com
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial legal entity & invoicing onboarding for Stratus Supply

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks — I can get most of this over today. A couple quick clarifying questions from our side: 

1) Tax form: we are a US entity and will send a completed W-9 (attached).
2) Payment terms: do you require Net30 POs or do you have a different standard for new supplier setups?
3) ACH: we'll share a bank detail PDF but would you prefer the CSV template you mentioned?

Attached is our W-9 and a masked bank info sheet. I copied our AP mailbox for anything that needs to be signed or returned. Once we confirm the PO header fields and remittance address we can return signed copies of your vendor form.

Attachments: stratus_w9.pdf, bank_details.pdf

Best,
Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Accounts
Stratus Supply
j.blake@stratus-supply.com | +1 (617) 555-0182
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial legal entity & invoicing onboarding for Stratus Supply

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply and the W-9. A few notes from Finance to keep this moving: 

- Redwood standard payment terms are Net30 by default for new suppliers; if you need alternative terms please flag and we can escalate.
- We prefer ACH for faster settlement. I have attached the Redwood ACH template and PO header spreadsheet so you can confirm what fields we will populate on the PO.
- Please confirm the exact legal name for the vendor record and the remittance address you want printed on POs/invoices. The law/tax name must match the W-9 to avoid tax withholding.

Attachments: redwood_PO_template.xlsx, ACH_template.csv
DocuSign packet (preferred): https://redwood.app/docusign/STRATUS-2028-05 — we can route this directly to accounts@stratus-supply.com for signature.

Once you return the completed onboarding form and bank confirmation we will create the vendor master and issue the initial PO (you should receive PO# RWIN-2028-00042).

Thanks,

Dev Patel
Sr. Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <j.blake@stratus-supply.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial legal entity & invoicing onboarding for Stratus Supply

Dev / Evelyn,

Thanks — confirming the legal name for the vendor record is: Stratus Supply, Inc.
Remittance address: 125 Harbor Way, Suite 400, Boston, MA 02110
We received the PO template and ACH CSV and will complete the DocuSign packet by end of day tomorrow. We are fine with Net30.
